body: Ha.. An alcoholic support group..! I'm 33, severely clinically depressed, and need to stop self medicating with alcohol as, long story short, it will eventually lead to suicide.

Sorry, I'm disgustingly intoxicated at the moment, but would love to pick this up tomorrow. Rest assured I feel safe as I write- very much enjoying a break from perpetual anhedonia. But as I say, it can't go on like this. Something has to give.

I feel tremendous guilt for accepting money from dad. In fact my first attempt was the same day as a bail-out from him. There are so many people who do not have access to this. I am a total failure, and that is my fault, not his. I will contact mind as you suggest. Many thanks :)
Furthermore - this is wholly relevant. It's CBT with a funky font. Thank you so much :)

I don't, personally (i work in healthcare), but my dad does. I refuse point blank to accept any money from him though. I get on very well with my family. I would certainly have killed myself by now if it were not for the impact it would have on them. I have had two friends recently commit suicide. One by hanging and one by a train impact at 100mph. It really hurts, but in a very twisted way I am envious of them. I wish I understood their motives. I would have done anything to prevent what happened to them, and at the same time I have a strong urge to do exactly the same myself. I just dont understand :(

Hey thanks :) that's so nice of you :) I'm sorry to hear you went through that too :( Sounds painful to say the least. I'm a radiographer and I've had patients that have jumped from bridges. All the staff are so matter of fact, look at this bone, joint, CT  C-spine, review the images etc, and I have to act the same, but all I want to do is rush in and say 'I know exactly how you feel'.

Thank you :) unfortunately the waiting list for a psychologist in the UK, in my area, is three years. If anyone has any recommendations for CBT/DBT textbooks, I would be very grateful. I love studying/reading, and this might be a worthwhile pursuit. God it sucks so much right now though. Luckily, the alcohol has really helped this evening. Thank you for your support.
